business_rules: UseCases depend on the journeys list; without stack, the cross-check has nothing to compare against.
behavior.summary: loadStack stats the path, gets ENOENT, prints stack_missing remediation, returns exit 2.

description: Precondition variation: write-usecase requires <project-root>/.harness/stack.json to exist. When absent, it prints `error: stack_missing: <path> — run /detect-sensors first` and exits 2 without touching the output directory.

evidence.rationale: loadStack stat branch with stack_missing remediation.

expected_outcome.summary: Stderr matches `error: stack_missing: ... — run /detect-sensors first`; exit 2.

name: Abort with stack_missing remediation when stack.json is absent

trigger.summary: Skill invokes write-usecase.go in a project that has never run /detect-sensors.
